import MumfordLib.SimplicialCochainGluing
import MumfordLib.SingularCupProductGeneral

/-!
# Alexander--Whitney cups on simplicial cochains

The front-face/back-face product extends to every simplicial set. Its naturality
allows the product to pass through the restrictions in Mayer--Vietoris.
The specialization to the singular simplicial set is the existing singular cup.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open CategoryTheory Opposite AlgebraicTopology
open scoped Simplicial

namespace Mumford.Analytic

variable {K L : SSet} {p q n : ℕ}

@[simp]
theorem simplicialCochainEval_zero (σ : K.obj (op ⦋n⦌)) :
    simplicialCochainEval (0 : IntegralSimplicialCochain K n) σ = 0 := by
  simp [simplicialCochainEval]

@[simp]
theorem simplicialCochainEval_add (φ ψ : IntegralSimplicialCochain K n)
    (σ : K.obj (op ⦋n⦌)) :
    simplicialCochainEval (φ + ψ) σ =
      simplicialCochainEval φ σ + simplicialCochainEval ψ σ := by
  simp [simplicialCochainEval]

@[simp]
theorem simplicialCochainEval_smul (a : ℤ) (φ : IntegralSimplicialCochain K n)
    (σ : K.obj (op ⦋n⦌)) :
    simplicialCochainEval (a • φ) σ = a * simplicialCochainEval φ σ := by
  simp [simplicialCochainEval]

/-- The Alexander--Whitney product on the front and back faces, with their
shared vertex in position `p`. -/
def simplicialCochainCup (φ : IntegralSimplicialCochain K p)
    (ψ : IntegralSimplicialCochain K q) (h : p + q = n) :
    IntegralSimplicialCochain K n :=
  simplicialCochainOfFunction (fun σ =>
    simplicialCochainEval φ (K.map
      (SimplexCategory.subinterval 0 p (by omega)).op σ) *
    simplicialCochainEval ψ (K.map
      (SimplexCategory.subinterval p q (by omega)).op σ))

@[simp]
theorem simplicialCochainCup_eval (φ : IntegralSimplicialCochain K p)
    (ψ : IntegralSimplicialCochain K q) (h : p + q = n)
    (σ : K.obj (op ⦋n⦌)) :
    simplicialCochainEval (simplicialCochainCup φ ψ h) σ =
      simplicialCochainEval φ (K.map
        (SimplexCategory.subinterval 0 p (by omega)).op σ) *
      simplicialCochainEval ψ (K.map
        (SimplexCategory.subinterval p q (by omega)).op σ) := by
  simp [simplicialCochainCup]

/-- Bilinearity of the integral simplicial cup. -/
def simplicialCochainCupBilinear (K : SSet) (p q n : ℕ) (h : p + q = n) :
    IntegralSimplicialCochain K p →ₗ[ℤ] IntegralSimplicialCochain K q →ₗ[ℤ]
      IntegralSimplicialCochain K n where
  toFun φ :=
    { toFun := fun ψ => simplicialCochainCup φ ψ h
      map_add' ψ χ := by
        apply integralSimplicialCochain_ext
        intro σ
        simp [mul_add]
      map_smul' a ψ := by
        apply integralSimplicialCochain_ext
        intro σ
        simp [mul_left_comm] }
  map_add' φ ψ := by
    ext χ : 1
    apply integralSimplicialCochain_ext
    intro σ
    simp [add_mul]
  map_smul' a φ := by
    ext ψ : 1
    apply integralSimplicialCochain_ext
    intro σ
    simp [mul_assoc]

@[simp]
theorem simplicialCochainCupBilinear_apply (φ : IntegralSimplicialCochain K p)
    (ψ : IntegralSimplicialCochain K q) (h : p + q = n) :
    simplicialCochainCupBilinear K p q n h φ ψ = simplicialCochainCup φ ψ h := rfl

@[simp]
theorem simplicialCochainCup_zero_left (ψ : IntegralSimplicialCochain K q)
    (h : p + q = n) : simplicialCochainCup (0 : IntegralSimplicialCochain K p) ψ h = 0 := by
  apply integralSimplicialCochain_ext
  intro σ
  simp

@[simp]
theorem simplicialCochainCup_zero_right (φ : IntegralSimplicialCochain K p)
    (h : p + q = n) : simplicialCochainCup φ (0 : IntegralSimplicialCochain K q) h = 0 := by
  apply integralSimplicialCochain_ext
  intro σ
  simp

theorem simplicialCochainCup_sub_right (φ : IntegralSimplicialCochain K p)
    (ψ χ : IntegralSimplicialCochain K q) (h : p + q = n) :
    simplicialCochainCup φ (ψ - χ) h =
      simplicialCochainCup φ ψ h - simplicialCochainCup φ χ h :=
  (simplicialCochainCupBilinear K p q n h φ).map_sub ψ χ

theorem simplicialCochainCup_smul_right (a : ℤ) (φ : IntegralSimplicialCochain K p)
    (ψ : IntegralSimplicialCochain K q) (h : p + q = n) :
    simplicialCochainCup φ (a • ψ) h = a • simplicialCochainCup φ ψ h :=
  (simplicialCochainCupBilinear K p q n h φ).map_smul a ψ

/-- Simplicial restriction preserves the cup product. -/
theorem simplicialCochainPullback_cup (f : K ⟶ L)
    (φ : IntegralSimplicialCochain L p) (ψ : IntegralSimplicialCochain L q)
    (h : p + q = n) :
    simplicialCochainPullback f n (simplicialCochainCup φ ψ h) =
      simplicialCochainCup (simplicialCochainPullback f p φ)
        (simplicialCochainPullback f q ψ) h := by
  apply integralSimplicialCochain_ext
  intro σ
  simp only [simplicialCochainPullback_eval, simplicialCochainCup_eval]
  congr 1
  · exact congrArg (simplicialCochainEval φ)
      (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (f.naturality _) σ).symm
  · exact congrArg (simplicialCochainEval ψ)
      (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (f.naturality _) σ).symm

/-- The general simplicial cup specializes to the existing singular cup. -/
@[simp]
theorem simplicialCochainCup_toSSet {X : TopCat}
    (φ : IntegralSingularCochain X p) (ψ : IntegralSingularCochain X q)
    (h : p + q = n) :
    simplicialCochainCup (K := TopCat.toSSet.obj X) φ ψ h =
      singularCochainCup φ ψ h := rfl

/-- The coboundary evaluates as the alternating sum over faces. -/
theorem simplicialCochainDifferential_eval (φ : IntegralSimplicialCochain K n)
    (σ : K.obj (op ⦋n + 1⦌)) :
    simplicialCochainEval (simplicialCochainDifferential K n φ) σ =
      ∑ i : Fin (n + 2), (-1 : ℤ) ^ i.val * simplicialCochainEval φ (K.δ i σ) := by
  simp [simplicialCochainDifferential, simplicialCochainEval, ← Category.assoc,
    SSet.ιChainComplex_d]

end Mumford.Analytic
